kf: Valid consent is **informed, voluntary and given with capacity**.
**Montgomery (2015)** and GMC (2020): discuss **material risks** and reasonable alternatives, including **doing nothing**.
Common complications: bleeding, infection, wound dehiscence, stretched or hypertrophic scars, keloids, nerve injury, recurrence.
**Danger zones**: temporal branch of the facial nerve, marginal mandibular branch, spinal accessory nerve (posterior triangle).
Track every specimen: refer unexpected malignant histology within NG12 timeframes.
myths: **"A signed form is consent"**: consent is the discussion; the form records it.
patho_lead: Complications are mostly **predictable from patient, site and technique**.

mech.t: Contamination, site (groin, lower leg) and host factors (diabetes).
High-tension sites (back, chest, shoulders) stretch scars and dehisce.
Superficial nerves at danger zones are easily cut.

prog: Most minor skin surgery heals without problems.
